name: Blackjack
summary: Casino banking card game where players try to beat the dealer by reaching 21 without busting.
rules_text: Use a standard 52-card deck. Card values: Ace counts as 1 or 11, face cards count as 10, others at pip value. One player is dealer. Each player and dealer get two cards, one dealer card face down. Players act in turn: they may hit to draw additional cards or stand to keep current total. If a player's total exceeds 21 they bust and lose immediately. After all players stand or bust, dealer reveals hidden card and must hit until total is at least 17. Dealer busts if over 21. Otherwise totals are compared: higher total without busting wins, equal is push, dealer wins ties except Blackjack. A natural 21 on first two cards is Blackjack and beats other 21s.
rating_reason: Blackjack is specific but mostly luck vs banker, little bluffing/bidding.
